modmenu.descriptionTranslation.bebpm: Bookshelves power an enchanting table from a configurable area around it, and blocks in between no longer block that power.
bebpm.config.title: Better Enchantment Bookshelf Placement
bebpm.config.radius_x.tooltip.1: Blocks reached east and west of the table.
bebpm.config.radius_z.tooltip.1: Blocks reached north and south of the table.
bebpm.config.line_of_sight.off.label: Off:
bebpm.config.line_of_sight.off.1: Blocks between table and shelf are ignored,
bebpm.config.line_of_sight.off.2: so shelves can be walled in or buried.
bebpm.config.line_of_sight.decor_only.1: Decorations may sit between table and shelf,
bebpm.config.line_of_sight.decor_only.2: but shelves cannot be walled in or buried.
bebpm.config.line_of_sight.on.label: On:
bebpm.config.line_of_sight.on.1: Restores the vanilla requirement for a clear gap.
bebpm.config.decor_permeable.tooltip.1: Extra blocks that should not block power on Decor Only.
bebpm.config.decor_permeable.tooltip.3: Or a tag with a hash, e.g. #c:glass_blocks
bebpm.config.decor_permeable.invalid: Not a valid block id or tag
